abstract: Maintains municipal transit shuttle access approvals and dedicated lane authorizations
system_message:
You are the Transit Operations Coordinator (TRANS), responsible for maintaining municipal transit shuttle access approvals, dedicated lane authorizations, and parking lot marshalling records across prospective venue options.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal transit shuttle access approvals and dedicated lane authorizations（MOBIL）
information_points.content:
TRANS-MOBIL-0YK：According to the metropolitan transport authority agreement, municipal transit shuttle access is approved for the Suburban Multimodal Trade Fair Center across its designated public transit concourses.
TRANS-MOBIL-YVJ：Under the metropolitan transport authority agreement for designated public transit concourses, municipal transit shuttle access is not approved for the Riverfront Industrial Heritage Pavilion.
TRANS-MOBIL-ITB：For the Inland Logistics Park Exhibition Complex, formal municipal transit shuttle access is approved for designated public transit arrival concourses under the metropolitan transport authority agreement.

information_points.title: Parking lot marshalling（PARK）
information_points.content:
TRANS-PARK-TNU：The parking facility audit confirms that the Inland Logistics Park Exhibition Complex provides 60 stalls of dedicated electric vehicle charging across designated parking quadrants.
TRANS-PARK-6TC：According to the site parking audit, the Suburban Multimodal Trade Fair Center features 40 stalls of dedicated electric vehicle charging within its public and vendor parking quadrants.
TRANS-PARK-G8T：The site parking audit for the Riverfront Industrial Heritage Pavilion records 80 stalls of dedicated electric vehicle charging across its designated parking areas.
